trips.note: The Mountaineer (CP No. 13), June 29 to September 3 from Chicago. Chicago - Minneapolis as C&NW No. 403 (over the Milwaukee Road St. Paul - Minneapolis); Minneapolis - Portal over the Soo Line (times of Soo No. 3, September 1947 table: the summer Soo table is not in hand); CP No. 13 from North Portal (Table 108) by Moose Jaw (Tables 6) on to Vancouver. Shown in Pacific time: two hours earlier than the Central time printed, an hour earlier than the Mountain time.

The Mountaineer (CP No. 14), July 5 to September 4 into Chicago. CP No. 14 by Moose Jaw to North Portal (Table 108); Portal - Minneapolis over the Soo Line (times of Soo No. 4, September 1947 table: they do not meet C&NW 404's 6.25 a.m. Minneapolis departure); Minneapolis - Chicago as C&NW No. 404. Shown in Pacific time: two hours earlier than the Central time printed, an hour earlier than the Mountain time.
